mapper.insert: insert into feedback(user_id, book_id, book_name, username, remark, status, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{bookName}, #{username}, #{remark}, 0, now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, book_id, book_name, username, remark, status, create_time, handle_time, handle_remark from feedback order by create_time desc
select id, user_id, book_id, book_name, username, remark, status, create_time, handle_time, handle_remark from feedback where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
select id, user_id, book_id, book_name, username, remark, status, create_time, handle_time, handle_remark from feedback where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update feedback set status = #{status}, handle_time = now(), handle_remark = #{handleRemark} where id = #{id}
